summary: REQ-2 styling/theme work appears implemented across App, LoginPage, AppShell header, global CSS (theme tokens + tab/dialog/page surface utility classes), and several dialogs. However, REQ-1 removal of the profile setup flow is not fully satisfied because the ProfileSetupDialog still exists and appears to still contain profile-setup UI/strings, which violates the requirement that users are never prompted and that no such UI elements exist.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove the profile setup flow so authenticated users are never prompted to complete a "Set up your profile" dialog, and the app remains usable even when the caller has no saved profile.
missing_requirements.reason: While App.tsx now renders AppShell directly after authentication, the ProfileSetupDialog component still exists and is described as a profile setup modal (implying the flow/UI was not removed). This conflicts with the acceptance criteria requiring no "Set up your profile" / "Welcome! Set up your profile" UI elements in the running app.

hallucinated_features.description: Profile setup modal/dialog UI was kept and restyled (ProfileSetupDialog).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly asks to remove the profile setup flow and ensure users are never prompted to complete it; keeping/updating a ProfileSetupDialog is contrary to the requested removal.
